name: io.github.MarcinGadomski94/switchboard
title: Switchboard
description: Run and supervise many Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode agents from one local web app.

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP port of the web app on 127.0.0.1 (1-65535).

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the token and the database; default is the per-user app-data folder (macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Switchboard).

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_CLAUDE_BIN
environmentVariables.description: The Claude Code CLI: a name, a path, or a JSON argv array.

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_CODEX_BIN
environmentVariables.description: The Codex CLI, same format as SWITCHBOARD_CLAUDE_BIN; optional, Settings > CLIs can override it.

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_OPENCODE_BIN
environmentVariables.description: The OpenCode CLI, same format as SWITCHBOARD_CLAUDE_BIN; optional, Settings > CLIs can override it.

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_GH_BIN
environmentVariables.description: The GitHub CLI used to read pull requests of worktrees, same format as SWITCHBOARD_CLAUDE_BIN.

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_TAILSCALE_BIN
environmentVariables.description: The Tailscale CLI used by the optional peer listener, same format as SWITCHBOARD_CLAUDE_BIN.

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_SETUP_WIZARD
environmentVariables.description: off keeps the first-run setup wizard from opening by itself; any other value means on.

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_UI_THEME_DEFAULT
environmentVariables.description: The UI a browser shows until a theme is chosen: v2 (Switchboard 2) or classic (the 1.x UI).

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_UPDATES
environmentVariables.description: off switches the updater off (no GitHub checks, no banner).

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_UPDATE_REPO
environmentVariables.description: owner/name of the GitHub repository whose releases are checked (forks).

environmentVariables.name: SWITCHBOARD_NPM_BIN
environmentVariables.description: The npm that runs npm ci in a staged release, as an argv prefix; default is the npm next to node.
